note: NEW preregister S1h2_es_select_fix (not quiet revision of S1h). Fixes S1h best-individual rebuild-after-theta-update bug: save best_vec BEFORE theta update; after training independently re-eval center and best_vec (K=16) and hand over higher. Keeps standard OpenAI-ES step (lr/sigma)*g. Retune lr on seeds 100-103 by same pre-written rule. Acceptance C1-C6 identical to S1g/S1h. Leak VOID N=4 Dx2 mean>0.35. VOID denom=8. Seeds = Dx2 clean. STOP after report; do NOT auto-open E2.
tune_rule: Tune ONLY lr of standard-step arms, ONLY on tune seeds 100-103, ONLY over lr_grid, ONLY by lr_selection_rule. NEVER tune on science seeds.
lr_grid_note: per-coordinate step ~ lr/(sigma*sqrt(n)) = lr*1.5625 -> {0.008, 0.016, 0.031, 0.078}; Salimans 2017 Adam lr 0.01 ~ 0.01/coord; legacy S1g step ~0.0005/coord
lr_selection_rule: Run ES_main (N=4,K[30,70]) on tune seeds 100-103 for each lr in lr_grid at full budget. Pick lr with highest mean greedy eval return (C1 return, 16 eps) over the 4 tune seeds. If top two within 0.02: prefer more tune-seed all_pass; then smaller lr. Chosen lr applies to BOTH ES_main and ES_easy (shared optimizer setting; easy is NOT tuned separately).
